summary: Tenthredon (Ancient Greek Τενθρηδών) was a Magnesian hero, descendant of Magnes through Haemon and Hyperochus, and father of Prothous, who leads the Magnetes from Pelion and the Peneius with forty black ships in Homer's Catalogue of Ships.
etymology: Tenthredṓn is a Magnesian personal name preserved chiefly through his son's catalogue entry.

sections.heading: Father of Prothous
paragraphs: Homer names Prothous son of Tenthredon as captain of the Magnetes (Iliad 2.756–759). Apollodorus' Epitome and Hyginus repeat the fatherhood; Eustathius and Tzetzes sketch the Haemon–Hyperochus descent from Magnes.
His wife is named Eurymache or Cleobule daughter of Eurytus in the mythographic notes. The atlas id tenthredon-magnesia is this Magnesian father only.
